 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE JITENDRA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 4 05-12-2024 Heard on the point of Admission.

2. Admit.
3. Call for the Lower Court Record from learned District and Sessions Judge, Begusarai in Complaint Case No. 1693C of 2004, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Begusarai.
4.

At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner is pressing I.A. No. 01 of 2024, filed for suspension of sentence and enlargement of the petitioner on bail during pendency of this case submitting that the petitioner has already spent about one year in jail, whereas he has been sentenced to two years S.I. and a fine of Rs. 1,000/- under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Patna High Court CR. REV. No.519 of 2022(4) dt.05-12-2024 Code and in default to pay the fine,
additional S.I. for three months.

5. Considering the custody of the petitioner, sentence is suspended and the petitioner is directed to be released on bail during pendency of this petition on his furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.
